book.name: Lea Fakatātā
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI LEA FAKATĀTĀ

content.text: ‌ʻE hoku foha, ke ke maʻu ʻeku ngaahi lea,
pea ke tānaki kiate koe ʻa ʻeku ngaahi fekau.
Fai ki heʻeku ngaahi fekau pea moʻui ai!
Pea tokangaʻi ʻa ʻeku fono ʻo hangē ko ho kanoʻi mata.
Nonoʻo ia ki ho louhiʻi nima,
tohi ia ki he kakano ʻo ho loto.
Ke ke lea ʻo pehē ki he poto, “Ko hoku tokoua koe;”
pea ke ui ʻae ʻilo ko ho kāinga fefine:
Koeʻuhi ke na fakamoʻui koe mei he fefine muli,
mei he muli ʻoku fakaoloolo ʻaki ʻene ngaahi lea.
He naʻaku sio atu mei he matapā ʻa hoku fale mei he matapā sioʻata.
Pea naʻaku vakai ki he kakai vale,
pea ne u ʻiloʻi ʻi he kau talavou ʻae tangata talavou ʻoku masiva ʻi he poto,
Naʻe ʻalu atu ʻi he hala ʻo ofi ki hono ʻapi;
ʻo ne ʻalu ʻi he hala ki hono fale,
‌ʻI he efiafi poʻuli,
ʻi he pō ʻuliʻuli mo fakapoʻuli:
Pea vakai, naʻe fakafetaulaki mai kiate ia ʻae fefine ʻoku kofu ʻi he kofu ʻoe faʻa feʻauaki,
ʻo loto kākā.
(ʻOku faʻa longoaʻa ia mo angamālohi,
ʻoku ʻikai nofo hono vaʻe ʻi hono fale:
Ko eni ʻoku ʻituʻa, ko ʻena ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi hala,
ʻoku ne nofo toitoi ʻi he tuliki kotoa pē.)
Pea naʻa ne puke ia, pea ʻuma ki ai,
pea ʻi he mata fiematamuʻa naʻa ne pehē kiate ia,
“ʻOku ou maʻu ʻae ngaahi foaki fakalelei;
pea kuo u fakamoʻoni ki heʻeku ngaahi fuakava ʻi he ʻaho ni.
Ko ia kuo u haʻu ai ke ta feʻilongaki mo koe,
ke kumi ʻi he feinga ki ho mata,
pea ko eni kuo u maʻu koe.
Kuo u teuteu hoku mohenga ʻaki ʻae ngaahi puipui matamatalelei,
mo e tongi fakasanisani, mo e tupenu lelei mei ʻIsipite.
Kuo u fakanamu kakala ʻa hoku mohenga ʻaki ʻae mula, mo e ʻalosi, pea mo e sinamoni.
Haʻu, ke ta fakafonu ʻakitaua ʻi he ʻofa ʻo aʻu ki he ʻapongipongi:
ke ta fakafiemālie ʻakitaua ʻi heʻeta fai ʻofa.
He ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ʻapi ʻae tangataʻeiki,
kuo ʻalu ia ʻo fononga mamaʻo:”
Kuo ne ʻave mo ia ʻae kato paʻanga,
pea ʻe ʻikai haʻu ia kaeʻoua ke hokosia hono ʻaho kuo ne lea ki ai.
Naʻa ne fakavaivaiʻi ia ʻaki ʻa ʻene ngaahi lea matamatalelei,
ʻo ne maʻu ia ʻi he fakaoloolo ʻa hono ngutu.
Ko ia naʻa ne ʻalu muimui leva ʻiate ia,
ʻo hangē ko e pulu ke tāmateʻi,
pea hangē ko e vale ki he tautea ʻoe ʻakau fakamaau vaʻe;
Kaeʻoua ke ʻasi ʻae ngahau ki hono ʻate;
ʻio, ʻo hangē ko e manu ʻoku ʻoho vave ki he tauhele,
ʻo ʻikai ke ne ʻilo ko e meʻa ke ʻosi ai ʻene moʻui.
‌ʻE fānau, ke mou fanongo eni kiate au,
pea mou tokanga ki he ngaahi lea ʻa hoku ngutu.
‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ke ʻalu atu ho loto ki hono hala,
ʻoua naʻa mou hē ʻi hono ngaahi ʻaluʻanga.
He kuo lī hifo ʻe ia ʻae toko lahi kuo lavea;
ʻio, kuo tāmateʻi ʻe ia ʻae kau tangata mālohi toko lahi.
Ko hono fale ko e hala ia ki heli,
ʻoku ʻalu hifo ia ki he nofoʻanga ʻoe mate.
